changeinfo.changes: Advances tutorial for special shot without perfect timing. Spelling correction. Fix for bug with NG+ version of LOKI boss fight. Awards 5 credits for each astronaut rescued. Extends the wall on path selection for Level 1. Adjusted unlock location for Twin Breaker Easter Egg.
Fix for bug with FRIGG boss fight.

Improved performance and boot time. Smoother player movement. Fixes to amplified sounds. Additional check from Boost Rush Mode trophy. Debris added to Boost Rush Mode. Boost Rush Mode Level 2 added. New hidden path and secret Boss. Enemy Compendium added. More enemies added to NG+ mode. NG++ mode added. Unlockable Journal Entries added. Boss E (SKULD) lead up added. Tweaking to boss patterns, difficulty and animation. Tweaking to enemy behaviors, difficulty, animation and locations. Boost recharge added, with additional boost rewarded when boosting through enemies. Tweaking to pickups drop rates to increase currency pickups and reduce boost pickups. Tweaking and balancing to special weapons. New menus system. New GUI for the map. Added ability to restart levels. Added ability to start levels with or without changing special weapon load-out. High Scores now displayed on map. New art for the map screen. New environments added. New design for the Advanced Arc Fighter. Fixes to the transitions to hidden paths. Fix to ensure shields carry over to hidden paths. New options for the aiming line. Option to turn voiced audio for pickups on or off. Changes to Boss Rush Mode. Updated Credits with additional names. Additional Ship Upgrades added.
Adds new trophies. Fixes audio group for 1 song. Ensures changes to aim line type take place instantly, where in some cases it wasn't.
Fixes potential crashes on ALVIS and KVASIR boss fights.
